goal: Put the whole site behind guest-list name matching, drive the RSVP off the guest list with per-person fan-out, and give the couple an invited-vs-replied admin roster.

shipped.title: Gate scaffold: middleware protection, name screen, and signed access cookie
shipped.summary: Stand up the whole-site gate plumbing end-to-end with a temporary accept-any-name match: middleware rewrites unauthenticated visitors to a name screen and issues a signed access cookie.

shipped.title: Theme palette/fonts self-serve edit surface
shipped.summary: Expose the nine theme color roles and the heading/body fonts as one self-serve edit surface in the single theme config, with a short pointer doc naming the exact file and how to change each value; the Team Lead fills the real values later.

shipped.title: Home hero drop-in wiring + pointer
shipped.summary: Deliver the next/image drop-in wiring for the home hero plus a pointer naming exactly where the photo drops in (path, filename, alt convention); a graceful placeholder renders until the real asset is filled in.

shipped.title: Generate the Guests allowlist tab from the Invitations tab
shipped.summary: First-pass Guests allowlist written and live: the official-guest-list tab holds header plus 65 guest rows across 40 parties (guest_id, name, party_id, side, plus_one_allowed); couple-reviewed, confirmed, and read-back verified row-for-row.

shipped.title: Allowlist matching: resolve a typed name against the Guest List
shipped.summary: Real allowlist matching replaces the accept-any placeholder — a Guest allowlist reader parses the Guests tab to a Guest shape and resolves a typed name against the live Guest List.

shipped.title: Guest-list-driven RSVP with per-person fan-out
shipped.summary: RSVP form is driven off the Guest List via the gate session — fetches the party by party_id, pre-fills who the Guest is, and fans out one attendance answer per person; confirmed working in prod.

not_shipped.title: Admin join roster: invited versus replied
not_shipped.summary: Admin roster joining the Guest List against RSVPs on guest_id (invited versus replied) was not built this sprint; the issue is relocated to the backlog root for Sprint 2.

decisions.title: Sprint 1 deployed live to production
decisions.summary: The guest gate plus guest-list-driven RSVP is live on the Cloudflare Worker (version cd83d58b, commit 846c530). Tag sprint-1-stable marks the rollback anchor. Team Lead confirmed gate entry and RSVP fan-out work in prod.

decisions.title: Guest List has deliberate guest_id gaps at g051 and g053
decisions.summary: During couple review two uncertain people were removed, leaving guest_ids g051 and g053 unused; their partners g050 and g052 were set plus_one_allowed TRUE. The gaps are intentional, not a generation error — downstream matching/RSVP/roster work should not treat missing ids as a defect.

decisions.title: Hero photo deferred to Sprint 2 on a Cloudflare size limit
decisions.summary: The drop-in hero wiring shipped against a graceful placeholder, but the real photo was not filled: the supplied asset is 28MB and exceeds Cloudflare's 25MB limit. The photo needs optimization before it can drop in, carried to Sprint 2.

retrospective_notes.title: Gate verdicts first written under a non-canonical step_logs key
retrospective_notes.body: The gate-scaffold (1800) QA verdicts were appended under step_logs (plural) rather than the schema/canonical step_log (singular), leaving the sprint record schema-invalid until caught and corrected at ship time. The canonical path is the sprint append-step CLI, which writes step_log — reinforce using it for all verdict appends.

retrospective_notes.title: Env contract for GOOGLE_SHEET_TAB was ambiguous and got overwritten
retrospective_notes.body: GOOGLE_SHEET_TAB was overwritten with a tab gid; gids are not tab names, and the Sheets values API addresses ranges by tab name, not gid. Worth documenting the env contract so the tab-name-vs-gid distinction is explicit.

retrospective_notes.title: No pre-merge CI — checks run only on push to main
retrospective_notes.body: Lint and cf:build run only on push to main, not on PRs pre-merge, so a broken merge is caught after the fact. Until pre-merge CI exists, lint + cf:build must pass locally before any merge.

retrospective_notes.title: Pre-existing hardcoded Georgia, serif fallback in .imageSlotLabel
retrospective_notes.body: A raw font-family fallback (Georgia, serif) predates this sprint and recurs across 8+ CSS modules; font-size is likewise untokenized. Captured as backlog issue 019eeb89 (tokenize font sizes into a theme type scale).

retrospective_notes.title: Color-only links lack a non-color affordance
retrospective_notes.body: Links are distinguished by color alone (no underline), an accessibility gap for color-vision-deficient guests. Noted for a later a11y pass.

retrospective_notes.title: Tooling debt: deprecated Actions and dead prod secrets
retrospective_notes.body: The GitHub Actions pipeline pins deprecated action majors (checkout/setup-node/pnpm v4 where v5 exists), and prod carries dead ADMIN_USER_2/ADMIN_PASS_2 secrets left from the collapsed dual-credential auth. Both are cleanup candidates.
